name: Anatomy Ace
label: ANATOMY CHECK

deepdive.note: One Anatomy Deep Dive a day at 18:00 from Nov 7, 2026 (Yashas approved Nov 6). The 18:00 slot posts a quiz when no new deep dive is ready.

formats.note: Two of the five daily quizzes rotate through five short formats (Yashas, Nov 6, 2026): Which bone is missing?, Zoom out, Diagnose this, Myth or fact, Rank these. Each day takes the next two in the cycle; a format with nothing ready passes to the next, and with nothing ready at all the slot posts a quiz. Keep it until the Strategist has data on which formats win.

rotation_note: Nov 6, 2026: on Instagram, bone and muscle quizzes about famous, feel-it-yourself parts got 750-1,400 views at 1 day (10 of 15 since Nov 1); organ quizzes (heart, lungs, abdomen, eye, teeth) got 128-417 (0 of 6). So the two daily 3D quizzes use bone and muscle regions only. The organ banks stay for later (deep dives cover organs).
ramp_note: Only the 09:30 and 20:00 slots use quiz stock now (the others are deep dives and formats), so 14 unused questions (a week) is enough for all 5 slots.
